data.name: Daaniyah
data.gender_notes: Daaniyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘dunya’, which translates to 'this world' or 'the present life'. The name Daaniyah, therefore, means 'abundant in this world' or 'fruitful'. The name Daaniyah carries the meaning “Fruitful, Giving” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Daaniyah usually hope their child will grow to embody fruitful, giving and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the abundance of blessings in one's present life, and encourages a giving nature towards others and the community.
data.etymology: Daaniyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fruitful, Giving.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daaniyah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: دانيّة
in_arabic.long_meaning: دانيّة اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، ويُشتق من كلمة "دانا" التي تعني الحكمة والذكاء، والتفكير العالي. وتُستخدم هذه التسمية في الثقافة الإسلامية لوصف الفتاة ذكية ومُحِرّمة.

in_urdu.name: دانیہ
in_urdu.meaning: اسم عورت، معنی ہے علم و حکمت
in_urdu.long_meaning: دانیہ، یہ عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ایک اسم علم مؤنث ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں حکمت، علم اور ذکاہت۔ یہ نام اسلامی تہذیب میں عورت کو دانشمند اور عاقل سمجھنے کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: दानीया
in_hindi.meaning: स्त्री नाम, बुद्धिमत्ता और ज्ञान का अर्थ है
in_hindi.long_meaning: दानीया एक अरबी मूल का स्त्री नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमत्ता, ज्ञान और समझदारी। इस नाम का प्रयोग इस्लामी परंपरा में बुद्धिमान और समझदार लड़की को दर्शाने के लिए किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: دانياه
in_pashto.meaning: نښه نوم، معنی او د هېندو او د انرې غوندې د
in_pashto.long_meaning: دانياه، په پښتو ژبه کې یو نوم دی چې معناي وي د هېندو او د انرې غوندې د. دغه نوم په اسلامي پرمختګ کې د دې نښه په توګه ورکول کېږي چې د لارښوونې او د پوهې په ځای د دې د سترگې د.

historical_references.context: Daaniyah was a Jewish sorceress mentioned in the account of the Prophet Solomon. She was said to have been a beautiful and talented woman, who lived during the time of King Solomon. According to the story, she was enchanted by Solomon's fame and wisdom, and submitted to his rule. However, when Solomon asked her to renounce her gods and worship only him, she refused, and was sent to prison. Later, she was released and compelled to serve as a cupbearer at Solomon's table. Daaniyah was eventually tricked into revealing her knowledge of magic, and was put to death along with her seven sons.

historical_references.context: Daaniyah is also mentioned in the works of the Muslim historian Al-Masudi. In his account, Daaniyah is described as a woman of great beauty and knowledge, who lived during the reign of the Umayyad Caliph Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik (691-705 CE). She was reportedly a Christian, and was renowned for her learning and wisdom. According to the story, she was invited to the caliph's court, where she was praised for her intelligence and wit. However, when the caliph asked her to renounce her faith and embrace Islam, she refused, and was imprisoned. It is said that she was eventually released, but continued to practice her faith in secret. Eventually, she was discovered, and was put to death, along with her three sons, for her refusal to convert.
